scheme_name: Interest Subsidy (For Micro, Small, Medium and Large New Industries)
other_conditions: The unit must have made the investment on or after 1 April 2017
At least 60% of the unit’s employment must be from the Union Territory of Puducherry and must be maintained for the period specified in the affidavit
The unit must be availing a loan from a financial institution for creation of fixed assets and/or working capital
The unit shall not transfer or dispose of the fixed asset, including plant and machinery, for five years from the date of application/disbursement of the subsidy, whichever is later
Additional investments after the first claim are eligible up to the ceiling limit
If the same proprietor sets up multiple units with different locations and separate licences/clearances, each unit is eligible as a separate entity
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro
Eligibility category noted in source: Small
Eligibility category noted in source: Medium
Eligibility category noted in source: Large
benefits_summary: Provides up to 25% interest subsidy on loan interest (capped at ₹5 lakh per annum) for a period of 5‑7 years depending on the location.
documents_required: Prescribed application form available on the Directorate of Industries and Commerce website
Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
